blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected the current five views and six pose renders. Back view still shows a broad faceted/folded patch across the upper posterior shoulder and a slab-like back panel; left/right views show abrupt planar transitions at the shoulder and torso. V120 cleared the sewn-topology preflight but did not resolve the visible posterior surface defect.

Direct inspection shows an almost entirely white outfit with a narrow lilac diagonal chest strip and sparse piping. Metallic lamé response and fencing-practice details are not visually legible in the current views.

Direct inspection of sit and crouch shows shorts/thigh intersections and abrupt skirt folds; prone retains a broad disk-like flare. Fit, final deform weights, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, and release packaging remain unverified.

Directly inspected the current front and three-quarter renders. The intended fitted jacket does not cover the chest and midriff: avatar breasts and abdomen remain visibly exposed from below the small diagonal plastron down to the waistband. This is a garment panel assembly/placement failure, not accepted styling. The candidate remains rejected until the jacket front visibly covers the intended torso region and new fit/pose evidence is reviewed.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
